verdict: LiveChat: Choose LiveChat when proven website live chat with Text suite expansion paths matters — and you accept per-agent pricing without a free tier. Scores use the customer-service editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Established live chat with clear Starter $19 entry
Mature reporting and staffing tools on Team+
weaknesses: AI and KB require add-on modules
Helpdesk ticketing not native without Text HelpDesk
Enterprise tier pricing needs live confirmation
bestFor: Teams wanting mature live chat with Text ecosystem optionality
SMB–mid-market website support with per-agent clarity
Buyers who may add ChatBot or HelpDesk from the same vendor
tradeoffs: Per-agent seats vs ticket/conversation caps and AI outcome pricing
Omnichannel breadth vs SMB simplicity in shared inbox tools
Suite upsell complexity vs transparent published plan floors
ITSM depth vs lightweight live-chat or ecommerce helpdesk fit
recommendation: Choose LiveChat when proven website live chat with Text suite expansion paths matters — and you accept per-agent pricing without a free tier. Compare Freshchat for a free 10-agent tier and Tidio for conversation-cap SMB pricing with bundled Lyro AI.
